function: RIS phase shift control minimizing V2V transmission latency; a Transformer predicts future RIS-aided channels (CPN), another outputs the phase shifts (PCN). pp. 1, 6
system: Downlink MISO V2X; BS with M = 4 antennas, 2 cellular users, 2 vehicle pairs; passive reflecting RIS N = 16×8; 5.9 GHz, 20 MHz. pp. 3, 12
method: Two Transformers: CPN trained supervised on NMSE, PCN trained unsupervised with a primal-dual Lagrangian; meta-learning pretraining with fine-tuning for new environments. pp. 9-12
data_channel: Synthetic RIS-aided V2X simulator with 3 paths, Gaussian-process angles, Gauss-Markov gains, geometry based on 3GPP TR 38.901; 80,000 training and 20,000 test channels. pp. 5, 11-12
test_conditions: Train 80,000, test 20,000 channels with distinct geometry; speed, N, Np, SNR sweeps; meta-learning pretrained on 5,000 diverse samples, adapted with as few as 25. pp. 12-14
baselines: Non-learned: ADMM-based phase shift control without prediction, random phase shifts, no-RIS system. Learned: LSTM-CNN phase shift control [1] and LSTM channel prediction [1]. pp. 12-13
metrics: V2V transmission latency, V2I SINR constraint failure rate, and channel prediction NMSE, versus training epochs, speed, N, Np, SNR. pp. 13-15
q1_support: p. 11: "based on the 3GPP standard (3GPP TR 38.901 [27])" for the scattering environment of the simulator; p. 12 adds its own path loss and complex normal small-scale fading.
q2_support: p. 13: "CPN with meta learning pretrained on 5,000 diverse V2X channel data points"; "when the size of training dataset is 25", the meta learning-aided CPN has 2 dB lower NMSE (Fig. 12).
q3_support: p. 13: "ADMM-based phase shift control scheme that employs ADMM technique" and "phase shift control scheme that employs LSTM for predicting the RIS-aided channels and CNN to design the RIS phase shifts [1]", compared on latency and NMSE in Figs. 10-16.
q4_support: p. 12: "the number of Transformer blocks is Lc = Lp = 3"; only hyperparameters are given, and no FLOPs, parameter count, runtime, or complexity order is reported anywhere in the paper.
q5_support: p. 12: "we synthetically generate a dataset comprising" its own samples; DeepSense 6G is only named as a possible extension (p. 11), and no code or data link is given.
notes: Area 3 because the main metric is the V2V latency obtained with the RIS phase shifts, and the channel prediction network is a means to it. q1 rests on p. 11, while p. 12 uses its own path loss and complex normal fading, so the reviewer should confirm. q2 rests on the meta-learning adaptation of CPN only (Fig. 12, p. 13). Table I (p. 13) lists simulation parameters, not complexity. Figs. 10 to 16 were also read on the page images.
